summary: Local clear-plate paintovers improved plate countability but remained too visibly composited. Refiner passes either preserved the pasted-plate look at low denoise or fused the row back into a connected ridge at higher denoise. IP-Adapter + ControlNet over the clear plate guide broke the body orientation or reinterpreted the guide as a shell/white ridge. The outputs are useful diagnostic references, but none should be promoted as app candidates or LoRA train_seed images.
primaryRejectReasons: clear plate paintovers read as pasted slabs rather than integrated bony plates
refiner d0.16 and d0.22 preserve the graphic guide look too strongly
refiner d0.30 starts fusing plates back into a connected dorsal ridge
IP-Adapter + ControlNet outputs rotate the animal away from side profile or drift into shell/ridge anatomy
four-spike thagomizer is still not reliably preserved with the improved plate signal
usefulFindings: Broad, separated plate silhouettes are now easy to create as project-owned structure guides.
RealVisXL can preserve plate shapes only when the guide is too visible; once naturalized, it tends to erase or fuse the plates.

The next useful path is not another RealVisXL ControlNet pass from the same guide. Use a stronger direct image model output as a reviewed synthetic seed, a real Stegosaurus-compatible LoRA branch, or train the custom stegosaur_plates_tailspikes LoRA after collecting enough cleared examples.
nextRoute: Keep clear-plate local outputs as control/reference material only. Do not add them to train_seed until the plate surfaces are integrated and the thagomizer is countable.
